The gait is the CL-05 walk of cad/params/CL-05.yaml with each foot placed on the ground under it (tools/cad/b3d/cl05_terrain.py). The static tip margin is the standing walker's centre of gravity over its support polygon, as in cad/metrics.json: with the joints frozen, and with the share of the slope lean the simulation assumes the gait leaves uncompensated (sim/spec/walker.yaml slope_lean).
Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CAD = computer-aided design · CG = centre of gravity · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · HAZ-nnn = hazard record (safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MuJoCo = Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact, the physics engine for the level-2 walker model · RAC = risk assessment code, severity category plus probability level (e.g. 1C) · SUS-A1 = dockable observation UAV · SUS-CAD-001 = the concept layouts document (cad/README.md); its drawing sheets are SUS-CAD-001-CL-nn · SUS-M1 = piloted walker · SYS-nnn = system safety requirement record (requirements/SYS-nnn.yaml) · TBD = to be determined · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
